item.text:
The schema change is ready against the repository contracts. [schema.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-NPx7g1/workspace/schema.sql) now protects audit records from updates, direct deletes and truncation. Demo purges run through a dedicated non-login role and check PostgreSQL’s foreign-key catalog for unhandled references before deleting data.

I added [test.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-NPx7g1/workspace/test.sql) and ran it successfully on PostgreSQL 18. It checks completion records, rejection of a delete after the app sets a custom flag, demo cleanup, preservation of real data, truncation protection, and diagnosis of a newly added restrictive reference.
